title: Reproducibility package: class-agnostic candidate generation and calendar-derived event windows for rapid landslide mapping
description:
Code, data definitions, per-image scores and result artefacts behind the manuscript Class-agnostic candidate generation and calendar-derived event windows for rapid landslide mapping, released on top of version 1.0.0 of the same repository (which documented the earlier journal version).

What the archive contains. scripts/ implements the Event-Bracketing Rule (f1_calendar_rule.py), the discovery baselines, the training-free separability criterion (LOFO and baseline variants) and the paired bootstrap. data/ holds the per-tile acquisition calendar (dates.jsonl), the per-tile separability features (features_15f.jsonl) and the derived-data definitions for the eight arm configurations. results/json/ holds every metric reported in the paper, results/per_image/ the per-image score arrays from which the paired confidence intervals are recomputed, results/logs/ the training and evaluation logs with the chain scripts, and results/run_configs/ the per-run configuration and test metrics. figures/ holds the published figures with their plotting scripts, and figures/ghnr/ the builders for the figure set used in this version. CHECKSUMS.sha256 together with verify_checksums.py allows every file to be verified before use.

Model checkpoints (33 GB) and the Sen12Landslides imagery (57 GB) are not included; both are described in the README and can be regenerated or downloaded (Hoehn et al. 2025, https://huggingface.co/datasets/paulhoehn/Sen12Landslides).
